title: No-Bake Almond Butter Oat Protein Bars
hookLine: Chewy meal-prep cookie-dough protein bars dipped in 80% dark chocolate with zero refined sugar.

items.name: Quick rolled oats + vanilla protein powder
Creamy almond butter + 1/4 cup maple syrup

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {pb_oat} and {pb_alm} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Mix Dough, Press Pan & Drizzle Choc
steps.instructionTemplate: Stir {pb_oat} and {pb_alm} with 2 tbsp almond milk until cookie-dough firm, press into a lined loaf pan, drizzle {pb_chc}, and chill 30 mins.
steps.creatorSecret: Use room-temperature dairy and eggs for No-Bake Almond Butter Oat Protein Bars, and pull it from the oven when the edges are set and a toothpick has moist crumbs—overbaking dries it out.

steps.title: Bake No-Bake Almond Butter Oat Protein Bars & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 4 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer No-Bake Almond Butter Oat Protein Bars to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 8 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 210 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
